tagline: Planned: an EDA environment for schematics, PCB layout, verification and simulation.
description: EH3D-PHOENIX-PCB is planned as an EDA environment with schematic capture, PCB layout, verification tools, circuit simulation and specialized modules for switch-mode power supplies and RF. Today it has the base of every repository of the suite and a written scope, requirements and dependencies; no code has been written and nothing has been run on a machine.
